items.title: Here's what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Bitcoin briefly drops to $17K on Kraken, exchange upholds trades
items.summary: Kraken said all orders were processed correctly and found no evidence of a security breach or compromised accounts.

items.title: South Korean exchanges halt CYBER transfers amid suspected bridge exploit
items.summary: Cyber reported unexpected minting of CYBER tokens on Solana, followed by tokens moving out of its Ethereum bridge lockbox, prompting an investigation.

items.title: Chainflip confirms $12M hack, offers attacker 10% bounty
items.summary: Chainflip offered the attacker a 10% bounty to return 90% of the stolen funds by Nov. 23, promising to treat the return as a white-hat recovery and withdraw law enforcement complaints.
